text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 633 Glengrove Avenue. The application indicates the reason for removal is to allow for the property owner to plant and tend a garden for health reasons. The subject tree is a black walnut (Juglans nigra) measuring 82 cm in diameter. The Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on December 16, 17 and 18, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 633 Glengrove Avenue.
